gaps.title: Claim data outside ClaimCenter.
gaps.detail: BillingCenter and ContactManager do not hold claim data. Claim-amount thresholds read 0 in those centres, and the ClaimNumber slots in their outbound records are blank or filler; record lengths are unchanged.

gaps.title: Navigation.
gaps.detail: The Albion screens in all four centres have no navigation entry point, because the base-product menus they hang from are not held in this repository.

gaps.title: Encryption.
gaps.detail: NI numbers and ContactManager bank details are encrypted at rest by `albion.security.AlbionAesEncryptionPlugin` (AES-256-GCM, keys from CyberArk); see `albion-config-and-brand-services.md` (Encryption at rest). ContactManager `LicenseNumber` and `TaxID` stay unencrypted until a hashed lookup column replaces their database-equality duplicate matching.

gaps.title: Rules for business review.
gaps.detail: - BillingCenter `AGI_ESCA_001`/`AGI_ESCA_002` and `AGI_PREU_001`/`AGI_PREU_006` have duplicate conditions. - BillingCenter `AGI_ESCA_009` and `AGI_PREU_007`, and ContactManager `vali_002`, fire on every record. - ContactManager `preu_006` duplicates `preu_003`.

gaps.title: POLARIS policyholder summary.
gaps.detail: The summary is carried on `ABContact` in ContactManager.

gaps.title: Mainframe confirmation.
gaps.detail: Program and dataset names in `AGIP709D` and `AGIC163D` are still to be confirmed against Endevor.

gaps.title: Unscheduled batch.
gaps.detail: Some interface feeds have JCL in `batch/jcl/adhoc/` but no Control-M job. The POLARIS heritage nightly sync is the first candidate for scheduling.

systemicIssues: Brand handling: typelist + varchar column + POLARIS codes (`integration/polaris/mappings/brand_xref.csv`) + XSLT logic — four sources of truth, checked by `tools/scripts/check_brand_config_drift.py`.
Three display-name formatters, three VRM normalisers, two rating engines, two complaint clocks.
`FeedStatus_Ext` drives the feed batches with no enforced state machine — see `FEEDSTATUS-STATE-MACHINE.md`.
IPT is computed in 4 places; month-end reconciliation is a runbook (`docs/runbooks/month-end-ipt-reconciliation.md`), not a control.
